# Repository Settings Guidance

This file is guidance only. It does not change repository settings.

## Recommended settings

- Repository description: public deployment repository for the Radiova website
- Homepage URL: <https://radiova-app.github.io>
- Topics: `github-pages`, `astro`, `pwa`, `radiova`, `deployment-only`
- Issues: enabled
- Discussions: optional
- Private vulnerability reporting: enable before publishing the security policy
- Settings path: Settings → Security → Private vulnerability reporting
- Pages source: `docs/`
- Default branch: `main`
- Branch protection: require review and status checks for public changes
- Social preview image: use a simple site screenshot or logo
- Release policy: no releases from this repository unless a public deployment note is needed

## Notes

- Keep the repository deployment-only.
- Keep public documentation synchronized with the private monorepo build output.
